answer: I would anchor trust in Observatory warden sextant arc seal attested by the stargazers guild. With each sextant arc is a measured star position plus a guild signature, so a farm must keep a hundred real observatories through winter, a single haven check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the onyx is a budget no epoch payout can repay. The ledge is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
